title: Engineer
jobDescription:
Company Overview: If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone! **Position Summary:** + This position is responsible for design/ engineering of pump packages, pump components, pump layouts and preparation of bill of material/project related technical documentation. **

RESPONSIBILITIES:
** + Ensure product safety through proper review/design and worksite safety through championing FLS policies and procedures. + Perform work that is varied and complex, with minimal supervision + Proficient in generating detailed 2D engineering drawings and complex 3D models, including hydraulic systems and assemblies, using Solid Works. + Capable of providing end-to-end engineering support for operational and functional initiatives with cross-functional dependencies. + Perform checking of own and other team members design/drafting work in compliance with design and drafting standards and fulfillment of engineering job requirements. + Strong knowledge of GD&T principles, machining drawing detail, tolerancing, and manufacturability requirements. + Drive strong engineering performance with respect to responsiveness, key indicators (OTD, KQI, utilization and efficiency). + Ability to sustain and improve key indicators using CIP techniques. + Prepare engineering standards/ procedures/ checklist/ learning points to minimize the errors for all types of assignments for responsible business units. + Effectively communicate and build rapport with business units. Enhance collaboration to achieve high customer satisfaction. + Demonstrate strong collaboration between team engineers and Supervisors. + Train associates within the team + Lead/ participate in standardization projects and create design document standards and participate in preparing presentation materials as necessary. + Knowledge of Bill of Materials (BOM) creation, structuring process. + Experience processing and releasing engineering drawings through Nexus, with familiarity in Oracle BOM systems considered an added advantage. **Position Requirements:** + Graduate Engineer in Mechanical Engineering with 4+ years with relevant experience in pumps or rotating equipment industry. + Knowledge of ASME / API/ DIN design standards and material specifications. + Excellent ability to read and understand engineering drawings/documents/reports. + Proficient on 2D and 3D CAD tools (Solid Works or similar CAD tools) + Must be conversant with GD&T (Basics & Advanced) and drafting standard ANSI Y 14.5 and ISO 8015 is a appreciated + Good understanding of Foundry practice and methodology with ISO
8062. **Competencies:** + Team player, who is highly self-motivated and open for challenging assignments. + Decision making on work priority and critical needs. + Quick learner, self-driven, collaborative and committed. + High quality on deliverables and timely responsiveness to internal and external customers. + Good verbal and written communication skills. Flowserve is a world-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000+ employees in 50+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence.
